Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking part in our RFP. As part of our vendor security review we need the following items from Redwood for the FinWorks evaluation packet: 

- Current vendor/subprocessor roster (names, roles, data access scope, country of operation).
- Any planned subprocessor changes or decommissioning expected in the next 90 days.
- Confirmation of logical tenant segregation between customers (high-level architecture diagram is fine).
- Key management model: do you use customer-specific KMS keys (BYOK) or shared keys? Key rotation policy?
- Copies or evidence of SOC 2 Type II AOC and latest penetration test summary; if any controls are scoped out please call them out.
- If any production workloads will be processed outside US regions, please list regions and subprocessors involved.

Can you get this back to us by 2027-11-10? If helpful, we can schedule a 30–45 minute call to walk through the items.

Regards,

FinWorks Inc.

5) SOC 2 & pen test: SOC 2 Type II AOC attached (soc2_aoc_q3_2027.pdf). Latest pen test summary attached; full reports available under NDA.
